# tailor_workspace_access (Resource)

The workspace access resource allows you to manage a platform user's role on a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Grant workspace access to a user
resource "tailor_workspace_access" "example_user_access" {
  workspace_id = tailor_workspace.starwars.id
  email        = "user@example.com"
  role         = "editor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email of the platform user. The user is invited to the workspace if they are not a member yet.
- `role` (String) The role of the workspace access. Allowed values are `admin`, `editor`, and `viewer`.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The grantee is identified by their email address.
terraform import tailor_workspace_access.example_user_access workspace/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/access/user/someone@example.com
```
